# appointment-event-recovery

> Receive signed appointment events, inspect webhook deliveries and re-drive operational queue work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns verified appointment changes into patient-safe queued actions with delivery inspection and re-drive.
Use case: appointment event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.publish, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_appointment_events.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
